item.title: When will your street be cleared after the snow storm?
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, MO - With a winter storm on the way, plow crews across the Ozarks are gearing up for a busy few days ahead. item.title: Keith Guttin: Life after a lifetime on the diamond
item.description: SPRINGFIELD--Keith Guttin spent more than four decades coaching, mentoring, and observing just about everything from the Missouri State dugout. item.title: Laclede County power outage leaves 1,400 without electricity
item.description: LACLEDE COUNTY, Mo. — Amid freezing temperatures, approximately 1,400 people are without power in Laclede County, according to a Laclede Electric Cooperative social media post published Friday evening, Jan. 23. The power supplier has experienced an outage at the Coffman Substation, impacting customers south of Lebanon toward Phillipsburg. The post says a crew is headed [...]

item.title: Major winter storm set to sweep through the Ozarks
item.description: A major winter storm is expected to impact millions of people across the region this weekend, with snow totals ranging from 4 to 13 inches and temperatures remaining very cold, resulting in wind chills of -5 to -15 degrees.

item.title: Tips for drivers ahead of winter storm
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — As winter weather approaches, Tim Fess, general manager at Rick's Automotive, reminds drivers to perform essential vehicle checks to ensure safety on the roads this weekend. Rick's Automotive often experiences an increase in service calls during winter events. item.title: 'Stay home' - MoDOT urges drivers to avoid snowy roads this weekend
item.description: Missouri state officials are asking drivers to "stay home" and avoid snow-covered roads this weekend as the state braces for an intense winter storm and plows work to clear major routes.

item.title: List of warming centers for impending winter storm
item.description: Warming centers and cold weather shelters are opening up across the Ozarks due to forecasted freezing temperatures and negative wind chills, with a list of shelters and warming centers available on the CPO website and the Missouri Department of Health & Senior Services website.
